title: What stays in the bill?
hook: A feeding bill can act like a filter.

knows: Birds have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The diagram separates particles from water as water passes a filter in the bill. Flamingo feeding and filter anatomy vary among species; the particles, arrows and spacing here are schematic.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: In a simplified flamingo feeding model, water passes the bill’s filtering structures. What is retained?

claims.text: A feeding bill can act like a filter. In a simplified flamingo feeding model, water passes the bill’s filtering structures. What is retained? The diagram separates particles from water as water passes a filter in the bill. Flamingo feeding and filter anatomy vary among species; the particles, arrows and spacing here are schematic.
claims.source: Unverified research starting point: OpenStax Biology 2e, Birds, https://openstax.org/books/biology-2e/pages/29-4-birds; species- or claim-specific citations require independent matching.

claims.text: The stage is a simplified schematic and the scenario is stipulated rather than observed.
A filter allows water through but retains suspended food. Which material collects by the filter? A filter can retain particles while water passes through.
